findings.explanation: The agreement requires you to perform additional consulting and related services requested by the company without any change-order mechanism or additional pay structure, creating a risk of uncompensated extra work.
findings.suggested_change: The Contractor agrees to perform the services specified on Schedule A. Any additional or extra services requested by the Client shall be subject to a separate written change order detailing the scope and corresponding compensation.

findings.explanation: Ownership of your work product transfers immediately upon creation through present assignment language before you receive full payment.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services, the Contractor shall assign to the Client all right, title, and interest in the deliverables created specifically for the Client under this Agreement.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to request a couple of adjustments before signing.
- Regarding the relevant clause, the arrangement creates the possibility of uncompensated extra work without a change-order mechanism; I propose that any additional or extra services requested be subject to a separate written change order detailing the scope and corresponding compensation.
- Regarding the relevant clause, ownership of the work product transfers immediately upon creation prior to receiving full payment; I propose that upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services, the contractor shall assign to the client all right, title, and interest in the deliverables created specifically for the client under the agreement.
Thank you for your time, and I look forward to moving forward.
